sentences.text: Geranopterus was an extinct member of the family Geranopteridae that lived in Europe.
The genus was formally named by Milne-Edwards in 1892.
Scientists recognize three species within the group: G. milneedwardsi, G. alatus, and G. bohemicus.
This animal existed from the late Eocene to the early Miocene, specifically between 37.71 and 33.9 million years ago.
